purpose: An ignored pending payload is destroyed before the caller receives the old reference-row snapshot; its destructor mutates the live cache through COW before a real forwarded next.
source:
<?php
class ReviewUnusedOld19 { function __destruct() { echo "A|"; } }
class ReviewUnusedNew19 { function __destruct() { echo "CACHE|"; } }
class ReviewUnusedArgument19 { function __destruct() { global $cache; echo "D|"; $cache[0] = new ReviewUnusedNew19(); echo "W|"; } }
function &reviewUnusedLeaf19() { global $cache; try { echo "C|"; yield $cache; echo "BODY|"; $tail = 17; yield $tail; echo "T|"; return 23; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function reviewUnusedMiddle19() { try { echo "M|"; $answer = yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "I|", $answer, "|"; return 29; } finally { echo "K|"; } }
function reviewUnusedOuter19() { try { echo "O|"; $answer = yield from $GLOBALS["middle"]; echo "F|", $answer, "|"; } finally { echo "Z|"; } }
$cache = [new ReviewUnusedOld19()];
$child = reviewUnusedLeaf19(); $middle = reviewUnusedMiddle19(); $outer = reviewUnusedOuter19();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind();
$row = $middle->send(new ReviewUnusedArgument19());
echo "S|", $row[0] instanceof ReviewUnusedOld19 ? "OLD|" : "BAD|";
$row[0] = null; unset($row); echo "X|";
echo "V|", $middle->current()[0] instanceof ReviewUnusedNew19 ? "LIVE|" : "BAD|";
$outer->next(); echo "N|", $child->current(), "|";
$outer->next(); echo "Q|", $outer->valid() ? "BAD|" : "DONE|";
unset($child, $middle, $outer, $cache); echo "E";

purpose: A present-null bare-yield cache supports no-advance initialization before a supplied argument-destructor throw; the last method receiver then closes the live chain and preserves the same exception.
source:
<?php
class ReviewUnusedThrowArgument19 { function __destruct() { echo "D|"; throw $GLOBALS["exception"]; } }
function reviewUnusedNullLeaf19() { try { echo "C|"; yield null; echo "BAD-BODY|"; } finally { echo "J|"; } }
function reviewUnusedNullMiddle19() { try { echo "M|"; yield from $GLOBALS["child"]; echo "BAD-TAIL|"; } finally { echo "K|"; } }
function reviewUnusedNullOuter19() { try { echo "O|"; yield from $GLOBALS["middle"]; } finally { echo "F|"; } }
function reviewUnusedThrowArgument19() { unset($GLOBALS["outer"], $GLOBALS["middle"], $GLOBALS["child"]); echo "DROP|"; return new ReviewUnusedThrowArgument19(); }
$exception = new Exception("unused19");
$child = reviewUnusedNullLeaf19(); $middle = reviewUnusedNullMiddle19(); $outer = reviewUnusedNullOuter19();
echo "P|"; $outer->rewind(); echo "H|", $outer->valid() ? 1 : 0, "|";
try { $snapshot = $middle->send(reviewUnusedThrowArgument19()); echo "BAD-RETURN|"; }
catch (Exception $caught) { echo "CATCH|", $caught === $exception ? 1 : 0, "|"; }
unset($caught, $exception); echo "E";
